shared_elements: large single anthropomorphic figure filling the field
long stylized hair falling in ordered locks over the shoulders
disc/rosette pendant worn on the chest
necklace or collar band across the chest
justification: Both depict a single dominant human figure with long, regularly ordered hair locks and a prominent disc pendant hung on the chest over a collar, a moderately specific combination. But A is a frontal, massive, largely undetailed figure with no arms or attributes visible, whereas B is a strict-profile winged figure with a raised hand, a bucket and cone, and elaborately patterned fringed dress, so the postures, attributes and rendering conventions differ sharply.
